summary.zh: 激进学生更容易接受组织理念，也更愿意参与行动。他们是扩张的快车道，但如果玩家决策失误，也可能迅速放大风险。
summary.en: Radical students are more receptive to the organization and more willing to act. They can accelerate expansion, but poor decisions may quickly amplify risk.

items.zh: 通常更容易被邀请加入组织。
items.en: Usually easier to invite into the organization.

items.zh: 更适合参与宣传、集会和高行动意愿任务。
items.en: Better suited for propaganda, rallies, and high-commitment tasks.

items.zh: 可以帮助玩家快速打开局面。
items.en: Can help the player accelerate momentum.

items.zh: 激进行动更容易引起管理层注意。
items.en: Radical actions are more likely to draw faculty attention.

items.zh: 如果玩家做出保守或失败决策，他们的信任可能快速下降。
items.en: If the player acts too cautiously or fails, their trust may drop quickly.

items.zh: 过度依赖激进学生会让组织更难保持低调。
items.en: Relying too much on radical students makes the organization harder to keep quiet.

items.zh: 适合需要快速提高影响力或推动关键区域行动时使用。
items.en: Useful when the player needs to quickly raise influence or push key region actions.

items.zh: 最好搭配侦查和压力管理，避免风险失控。
items.en: Best paired with scouting and pressure management to prevent risks from spiraling.
